# select. slot. 1.8.1 Ver. 9 — Miyoo

Long-press POWER during gameplay to shut down on the first hold. Slot queues the resume save in the background when you press POWER so the input loop can track how long you hold it. On OnionOS, Slot waits for pending saves before handing off to the system's themed shutdown. Tapping POWER still uses OnionOS standby.
